description.value: Little Ongpin Restaurant is a Filipino restaurant in Richmond serving an extensive menu of traditional dishes — grilled skewers, sinigang soups, congee, sizzling plates, and chargrilled rice — with many dishes portioned for groups and party trays available. The menu spans the full range of Filipino comfort food, from pork sisig and lechon kawali to a wide variety of seafood soups. It sits on Number 5 Road, a flat, bikeable corridor through Richmond's diverse food district.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and active (© 2025), fully corroborating the OSM name, address (4093 No. 5 Rd, Richmond, BC V6X 2T9), and phone number. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, takeout labelling, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so all amenity fields default to null per the absence-of-evidence rule.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active Filipino restaurant with a confirmed website, matching contact details, and published business hours. A useful food stop for cyclists on the Number 5 Road corridor in Richmond.
